description: This file contains the definition of the 'Controller' class within the 'Opencart\System\Engine' namespace. The class provides methods for managing registry-based dependencies, including constructor, __get, and __set methods. It is a core part of the OpenCart framework's engine, responsible for providing a base controller implementation.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: A base class for controllers in the OpenCart framework, managing dependencies via a registry and providing magic methods for property access.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Controller with a Registry instance.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Allows access to registry properties via object property syntax; throws exception if key is not found.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets a registry property via object property syntax.
